targetAudience.primary: Engineers designing digital-employee runtimes, streaming agents and safety guardrails
targetAudience.knowledgeAssumption: The reader understands asynchronous run loops, terminal exceptions and guardrails.
targetAudience.readerProblem: Several terminal conditions can race for one mutable exception slot, allowing a generic condition recreated during cleanup to erase a more specific safety event.

whyNow: A same-day merged OpenAI Agents Python change marks max-turn handling consumed at first materialization so final streaming cleanup cannot overwrite an input-guardrail tripwire.

externalHook.description: A failure recreated later can be older information with less semantic priority than the safety condition already observed.

coreProposition: Concurrent terminal conditions should use explicit consumption and arbitration state: once a generic condition has become a candidate outcome, replaying it during finalization must not erase later, more specific safety evidence, while external-effect state and the complete priority policy remain separate concerns.

originalValue.description: Reframes last-writer exception storage as a state-lifecycle defect and separates observed conditions, consumed conditions, surfaced outcomes and external effects.

readerTakeaway: Make terminal conditions single-consumption where policy requires, preserve all observed facts for telemetry, and test causal concurrency boundaries instead of relying on cleanup order.

supported: The max-turn handled flag is set when the default exception is first stored.
A later input-guardrail tripwire remains the surfaced exception through final cleanup.
The regression synchronizes the race with asyncio.Event rather than timing sleeps.
unsupported: Rollback or compensation for external effects
Equivalent behavior for every runner and guardrail type
uncertain: Which conditions should legitimately re-enter arbitration
Whether the API should expose a structured set of terminal facts

firstPartyRole.rationale: The article develops a general runtime arbitration pattern without relying on a first-party project.

decisionReason: The merged mechanism and deterministic regression support a precise, transferable state-consumption lesson with explicit limits.
